title: Calibration and Risk-Budgeted Decisions with System One Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19811v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM workflows and agents rely on a set of binary decisions like allow/block an input, or discard/retain a retrieved document. When human deferral is unavailable, uncertain cases must still receive an action. We study System One decision scores in this setting by defaulting to a conservative fallback when uncertain, and controlling the false omission risk within the subset of inputs assigned the utility-maximizing action. Across six datasets covering moderation, safety, and reranking, we compare general System One models with task baselines and a local open-weights fine-tuned System One model. We show that naive baselines for threshold selection exceed the target risk in roughly half of settings with defined test risk, compared with 7.8\% for Learn Then Test (LTT), which leverages finite-sample statistical guarantees. Our results show why relying on a probability-like interface is insufficient for deployment decisions and how risk-budge

translated_title: 基于系统1模型的校准与风险预算决策
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）工作流与智能体依赖于一系列二元决策，例如允许/拦截输入，或丢弃/保留检索到的文档。当无法进行人工转交处理时，不确定的案例仍必须被赋予一个动作。我们在该场景下研究系统1决策分数：在不确定时默认采取保守的回退动作，并在被分配效用最大化动作的输入子集内控制假遗漏风险。在涵盖内容审核、安全性和重排序的六个数据集上，我们将通用系统1模型与任务基线以及一个本地开源权重微调的系统1模型进行比较。结果表明，朴素的阈值选择基线在大约一半具有明确测试风险的设定中超出目标风险，而利用有限样本统计保证的Learn Then Test（LTT）方法仅超出7.8%。我们的结果说明了为什么仅依赖类似概率的输出接口不足以支撑部署决策，以及如何进行风险预算分配。
tldr: 该论文提出在LLM工作流的二元决策场景中，通过不确定时采取保守回退动作，并利用Learn Then Test（LTT）的有限样本统计保证来控制假遗漏风险，显著优于朴素阈值选择基线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a System One decision framework for LLM workflows that controls false omission risk by defaulting to conservative fallback actions when uncertain and leveraging Learn Then Test (LTT) with finite-sample statistical guarantees, substantially outperforming naive threshold-selection baselines.
